title: KINETIC
description: Autonomous 3D delivery journey and freight operations. Pinned 5-chapter route narrative with procedural electric truck Unit 104 travelling a 1,400-meter highway, live HUD telemetry tags, and interactive command center console.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · Three.js WebGL · Lenis

sections.title: 01 Ingestion (Hero)
sections.summary: Origin DC yard. Headline *"From One Click to Your Hands in 24 Minutes."*, live market ticker, and primary pill CTA *"DISPATCH ORDER #KX-9042"*.

sections.title: 02 Sortation
sections.summary: Optical induction scanning archway. Interactive item routing demo and live weight verification.

sections.title: 03 Transit
sections.summary: Arterial highway bridge at twilight. Live speedometer, battery level, route elevation grade, and countdown telemetry.

sections.title: 04 Megamarket Deals
sections.summary: Metropolitan distribution corridor. Flash-drop marketplace cards (Audio, Apparel, Battery) with live SVG connector curves linking items directly to the traveling truck.

sections.title: 05 Doorstep Arrival
sections.summary: Destination dock bay. Interactive tamper-seal unboxing demo verifying delivery handoff, plus client-side VIP Express instant dispatch form.

customCodeBlocks.title: KINETIC Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: KINETIC Interactive Runtime Bridge
customCodeBlocks.description: Loads three, lenis in page footer custom code with prefers-reduced-motion guard.
